about_the_game:
A Perilous Climb With Only Your Mouse

Join Bob on a grueling journey to the top! Bob to the Top is a high-stakes, precision platformer about a small creature with a massive goal. This entire challenge is controlled with nothing but your mouse.

Master the Mechanics

Master a unique and challenging physics-based control scheme. Your mouse handles everything:

  • Jump Click to leap.

  • Grapple Aim and shoot Bob's incredible tongue to latch onto distant platforms.

  • Swing Use your mouse movement to build momentum and swing across vast, open gaps.

  • Climb Carefully ascend and descend your tongue to position yourself for the next move.

This fluid combination of jumping, hooking, and swinging is your only way to overcome the ascent.

A True Test of Perseverance

This is not a game for the faint of heart. Inspired by brutally challenging "rage games" like Getting Over It, this game is designed to test your limits.

  • No Checkpoints, No Saves There is no safety net. A single mistake, a moment of lost focus, and you will fall. How far? That depends on your luck. Every significant fall sends you right back to the beginning.

  • A Single, Massive Map The game takes place on one enormous, continuous stage. The only way is up.

  • Calculated Challenges The platforms are spaced far apart, creating a "floating" feel that demands perfect timing. You'll also have to navigate moving platforms and dodge the occasional projectile obstacle.

Your goal is simple: reach the top.

The journey will be anything but.

Do you have the patience and skill to help Bob reach his goal?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 (2 Cores, 4 Threads @ 3.3 GHz) or AMD A8-7600 (4 Cores @ 3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 (2 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 550 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 275 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 (4 Cores @ 3.2 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 Cores @ 3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 275 MB available space

short_description: Bob to the top is a climbing game that you need to control. The Main character, Bob, goes to the top of the map to win the game. You can jump and stick to the wall to help Bob reach His goal.
